title: Build cross-population neighbor indexing
scope: Implement shared Slang neighbor traversal for two fluid systems without changing public capability claims.
acceptance: Cross-system neighbors are complete, bounded and do not alias system-local IDs.
Capacity/neighbor-overflow and zero-population tests cover both endpoints.
evidence: CPU Slang neighbor-index fixture passes duplicate-local-ID, boundary, per-endpoint overflow, and empty-population cases.
Slang CPU, CUDA, and Vulkan driver targets compile the shared fluid_emit_pair_cells and fluid_count_pair_neighbors kernels.
Typed pair storage planning bounds combined keys, identities, endpoint counts, diagnostics, and radix scratch.
